email.title: Email delivery
email.intro: Invitations for this workspace are sent through the provider you choose here. Settings are checked before they are saved, and nothing is saved if the check fails. Account email, such as verification and password reset, always uses the instance settings.
email.not_configured: No workspace email provider is set. Invitations use the instance email settings, if configured.
email.password_help: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the stored password.
email.domain_status: Sender domain status as of the last save
email.resend_step_1: Sign in to resend.com, open Domains, and add your sender domain. Add the DNS records Resend shows.
email.resend_step_2: Wait until the domain shows Verified. The sender address must use that domain.
email.resend_step_3: Open API Keys and create a key with Full access. Full access lets the save check read your domains.
email.resend_step_4: Paste the key below and save. The check only reads domains. Nothing is sent.
email.api_key_help: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the stored Resend key.
email.postmark_step_1: Sign in to postmarkapp.com, open your server, and add your sender domain. Add the DNS records Postmark shows.
email.postmark_step_2: Wait until the domain shows DKIM and Return-Path as verified. The sender address must use that domain.
email.postmark_step_3: Open the server's API Tokens and copy the Server API token. Postmark uses it to send mail.
email.postmark_step_4: Open the account's API Tokens and copy the Account API token. The save check reads domains with it. Paste both below and save. Nothing is sent.
email.server_token_help: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the stored Server API token.
email.account_token_help: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the stored Account API token.
email.account_token_set: An Account API token is stored. Leave blank to keep it.
